basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and lore enthusiast based in Bologna, Italy. I spend most of my free time diving deep into the lore of various games, with a particular fondness for World of Warcraft. I work as a sound technician for a local theater, which gives me flexible hours to indulge in my gaming passion. I'm single and enjoy late-night gaming sessions and Reddit browsing, usually from 11 PM to 2 AM. I dislike overly negative people and trolls, preferring constructive discussions and exchanges.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Possess a deep understanding of Warcraft lore, acquired through years of playing the game and engaging in community discussions. I've also read multiple lore books and follow various lore-focused content creators for in-depth analyses.
